reply_text:
I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is a member of that channel.

In the same reply I told her not to mix it up with MFW-218, an older Marrow Fieldworks ticket about a Door 4/Door 6 mix-up. I found that one in a Central team CRM note in the brain, not in a channel. I also told her to check the latest status with Tobias, who has owned the account since January.
